notes.title: Switch Pro Controller support + video of making Dig Dog without hands!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31190902/4151903455e64fcf6042446e393062d20cb6376f.jpg[/img]

[h1]Switch Pro Controller + More[/h1]

Dig Dog now uses SDL 2.0.9, the latest version. This allowed me to add proper support for the Switch Pro Controller! And Rumble now works with the Switch Pro and PS4 controllers.

There’s a lot more controllers supported too, thanks to the latest [url=https://github.com/gabomdq/SDL_GameControllerDB/blob/master/gamecontrollerdb.txt]gamecontrollerdb[/url]txt file. In fact, Dig Dog now supports 255 different game controllers!

This is timely, because I’ve just launched Dig Dog on the Nintendo Switch today! If you’re into games on Switch, check it out [url=https://www.nintendo.com/games/detail/dig-dog-switch]here[/url].

[h1]Look, no hands![/h1]

I’ve made a new video to promote the Switch launch. It introduces the game, talks about the new features, and shows how I made Dig Dog without using hands!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kvdeOs4nCyI

The code in Dig Dog was all written by voice using a made up vocabulary. It’s a weird thing to explain, so I’m happy to finally have a video that properly demonstrates this process.

Although the video is targeted toward new Switch players, all the features mentioned are now in the Steam version too. Enjoy!

[h1]If you have problems with this patch, please fill out the [url=https://goo.gl/forms/g3upR7xneCAB2m322]Bug Report Form[/url] to let me know what went wrong![/h1]

notes.title: Unlock Color Palettes…with BONES!
notes.content:
I made you a surprise holiday gift! What is it? A big update for Dig Dog! The headlining feature: Unlockable Color Palettes! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31190902/3155d07854b234e95b075f4cb7be9e784d55563c.png[/img]

[h1]Unlockable Color Palettes[/h1]
Dig up bones to unlock a variety of color themes! Swap between palettes to find one that matches your current mood. Can you unlock them all?

[h1]New Item: Coin Bark[/h1]
Find this item to add some bite to your bark! Bark to fire a coin as an explosive projectile. Enemies better watch out!

[h1]Quality of Life[/h1]
Many requested PC features have been added including adjustable screen shake and Fullscreen/Window mode switching.

[h1]SALE SALE SALE[/h1]
The game is now on sale for 33% off! I think it’s now time to get digging. (Or perhaps GIFTING?)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/655380/

[h1]Full Patch Notes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added unlockable Color Palettes
[*]New Item: Coin Bark
[*]Added a Video Menu
	[list]
	[*]Change color palettes (once unlocked)
	[*]Adjust screen shake
	[*]Fullscreen/window toggle
	[*]Adjust Window scale
	[*]Vsync toggle
	[/list]
	
[*]Added a Rumble strength setting
[*]Added an Options menu to the pause screen
[*]Added Korean localization

[*]Removed Item: Angle Dash
[*]Improved controller support. Now supports newer PS4 controllers and many more.
[*]Updated to SDL 2.0.8
[*](Mac) Improved Fullscreen mode
[*]Visual tweaks and bug fixes
[/list]

[h1]If you have problems with this patch, please fill out the [url=https://goo.gl/forms/g3upR7xneCAB2m322]Bug Report Form[/url] to let me know what went wrong![/h1]
